ambient_events: Somebody stops on the kerb to retie a shoe.
A street sweeper goes by on Sorrel Way with its brushes up.
A sparrow lands on the kerb, finds nothing and goes.
description: A strip of garden between Halcyon West Halt and the Recital Hall, with a stone-kerbed flowerbed, a clipped hedge and an urn. The rough meadow starts again behind it.
name: Sorrel Gardens
